senses.gloss: कैशव mf(ई)n. (fr. केश्˚), relating or belonging to Kṛṣṇa, Hariv. 15377; Ragh. xvii, 29.
कैशिक mf(ई)n. (fr. के॑श), hair-like, fine as a hair, Suśr.
कैशिक m. (in music) N. of a Rāga
love, passion, lust, L.
N. of a prince (son of Vidarbha and brother of Kratha)
of several men, Hariv.; VP.
कैशिक m. pl. N. of a subdivision of the Yādavas (descended from Kaiśika), MBh. ii, 585; Ragh.; Mālav.
कैशिक n. the whole mass of hair, head of hair, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 48.
कैशिकी f. (scil. वृत्ति) one of the four varieties of dramatic style (graceful style, suited especially to the passion of love), Bhar. xx, 45 ff.; Daśar. ii, 44; Pratāpar.; Sāh. (v.l. कौशिकी)
N. of a locality or of a river, MBh. iii, 10095
for कौशिकी (N. of Durgā), L.
कैशिन॑ mf(ई॑)n. (Pāṇ. vi, 4, 165) taught by Keśin Dārbhya, ŚāṅkhBr. vii, 4 (˚नी दीक्षा, also केश्˚ द्˚ N. of a number of Mantras, ĀpŚr. x, 10, 6)
descended from Keśin, Kāṭh. xxvi, 9; ŚBr. xi, 8, 4, 6.
कैशिन्य m. metron. fr. केशिनी, g. कुर्व्-आदि.
कैश्य n. (Pāṇ. iv, 2, 48) the whole mass of hair, head of hair, Naiṣ. iv, 114.
कैश्य See above.
कैशोर n. (fr. किश्˚, Pāṇ. v, 1, 129, Kāś.), youth, boyhood (from the age of ten to that of fifteen), BhP. iii, 28, 17
कैशोर—वयस् mfn. having the age of a youth, ix, 2, 15.
कैशोरक mf(इका)n. youthful, Bhpr. iv, 226
कैशोरक n. the youths and girls, Hariv. 4081.
कैशोरक—गुग्गुलु n. a kind of elixir, ŚārṅgS. ii, 7, 17.
कैशोरि m. patr. g. कुर्व्-आदि.
कैशोरिकेय m. metron. fr. किशोरिका, g. शुभ्रादि.
कै॑शोर्य m. (g. कुर्व्-आदि) patr. fr. कैशोरि N. of Kāpya, ŚBr. xiv, 5, 5, 22 and 7, 3, 28.
कैष्किन्ध mfn. coming from Kiṣkindhā g. सिन्ध्व्-आदि.
